methods.explanation: If the \(80^\circ\) angle is the vertex angle, the vertex angle is \(80^\circ\). If the \(80^\circ\) angle is a base angle, the vertex angle is \(180^\circ-2\times80^\circ=20^\circ\). Therefore, the vertex angle is \(20^\circ\) or \(80^\circ\).
